dedupe_keys.name: crc mobile access network infrastructure and coverage base station sites by operator municipality and technology colombia

description: This CRC dataset gives the mobile access network infrastructure and coverage reported by all Colombian network and service providers and spectrum licensees, under article 5.1.3.9 of CRC Resolution 5050 of 2016. Its infrastructure resource counts base station sites for each quarter, operator and municipality, split by whether the site is the operator's own or shared (co-located) and by the combination of 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G technologies installed; for example, the preview shows Comcel (Claro) with 283 own sites in Medellín carrying 2G, 3G and 4G in the second quarter of 2021. The coverage part is calculated from the coverage maps operators must report. The dataset was issued in December 2023, with the Postdata metadata last updated in February 2026 and the federated copy refreshed in September 2026. Coverage: all municipalities of Colombia, from 2021. Format and access: CSV download with preview, metadata in DCAT formats, free; no specific licence is stated. Caveats: counts per municipality, not site coordinates; operator-reported, and technology combinations must be summed carefully. Simulation uses: estimating the number and technology mix of mobile sites exposed to hazards in each municipality, and redundancy between operators for resilience analysis. Related records: the Postdata record describes the wider platform, and the Anatel open data give comparable Brazilian station data.
